description: This file contains client-side API functions to fetch user-related data such as user projects and basic user info from a backend service via HTTP requests. It includes two main functions: getUserProjects and getUserBasic, which make GET requests to specific user endpoints.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from the backend API using provided userId and parameters, returning project data including project IDs, names, and last activity dates.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves minimal user information such as ID and name for a given userId, handling 404 errors gracefully by returning null for the name.
